description:
Reads one strength-filtered open-lobby page under current blocks and active-owner checks.
Use when: explicit asynchronous multiplayer actions after reading horizon://docs/matches.
Not for: automatic polling, page traversal, timeout progression, invented winners or automatic rewards. Reconcile with horizon_get_matches and horizon_get_match. Consent and game consensus do not validate honest gameplay.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken.
Side effects: Read only, at most256 metadata candidates and50 results. Empty cursor pages are valid. No game state is returned.
Returns: {matches,nextCursor,pollAfterSeconds,serverTime}
Errors: 404 hides private/missing/expired matches. 409 REVISION_CONFLICT or STATE_CONFLICT: explicitly reread and reconcile the original intent, never replace the revision or automatically resubmit. RESULT_CONFLICT preserves the original report. RUN_EXPIRED/RUN_ALREADY_USED never allow replacement ranked runs. 501 FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED is explicit for simpleServer ranked mode. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

cursor.description: Previous consumed-only cursor; an empty page can have a continuation

limit.description: One explicit page of at most fifty summaries

maxStrength.description: Exact safe integer strength from the original search range

minStrength.description: Exact safe integer strength from the original search range

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken sent only as Bearer

userId.description: Active player matching the session and project

name: horizon_find_open_matches
